articles.title: Benjamin Netanyahu says Iran will never have nuclear weapons 'with or without a deal'
articles.summary: Netanyahu declared that Iran will not acquire nuclear weapons and cited successful Israeli operations against Iran, speaking at an IDF pilot graduation ceremony.

articles.title: Benjamin Netanyahu says Venezuela aid mission shows Israel's true colors
articles.summary: Netanyahu spoke with Israeli aid delegation leaders heading to Venezuela following earthquakes, praising their humanitarian mission.

articles.title: Benjamin Netanyahu coalition removes clause from Torah study bill to advance Knesset vote
articles.summary: Netanyahu's coalition agreed to amend the controversial Basic Law: Torah Study bill ahead of a Knesset vote to advance haredi-backed legislation.

articles.title: Benjamin Netanyahu reiterates concerns about US-Turkey F-35 sale
articles.summary: Netanyahu told CNN that the proposed US F-35 sale to Turkey would disrupt regional power balance, citing concerns about Ankara's ties to extremist organizations.

articles.title: Trump briefs Netanyahu on 'American moves in Gulf' in phone call after renewed US strikes on Iran
articles.summary: Netanyahu spoke with Trump about US military operations in the Gulf and reiterated concerns about the F-35 sale to Turkey and Turkish threats to Israel.
